name: t-test (one-sample, two-sample, paired)
when_to_use: Compare the mean of one group against a reference value, or the means of two groups (independent or paired); metric dependent variable, approximately normal.
notes: Compares the mean of one group with a reference value, or the means of two groups, and tells whether the observed difference is large enough not to be mere chance. Applications: before/after a campaign; comparing the performance of two branches.

expected_input.question: Is the difference between the means of one or two groups statistically significant?

pdca_use: Check phase: compare an indicator before/after an action, or between two units, with an auditable numeric result (statistic and p-value), no free-form narrative.

plain_explanation.purpose: Checks whether the difference between the means of two groups is real or could be chance.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When comparing two groups on a number (e.g., before and after).
plain_explanation.data_needed: A numeric column and one that splits the data into two groups (or two measurements of the same item).
plain_explanation.example: See whether service time changed after a new process.
plain_explanation.diagram: group A: mean 10 | group B: mean 12 -> is the difference real?
